step.cmd: Turn the VOLUME dial to control volume. Available volume range: 1 - 41.
Press MENU button repeatedly to select the Sound setting mode as below;

ul.li: BAS (Bass): sets the bass sound level. (-5 ~ +5)
MID (Middle): sets the middle sound level. (-5 ~ +5)
TRE (Treble): sets the treble sound level. (-5 ~ +5)
FAD (Fader: Option): sets the sound fade between the front and rear speakers. (F15 ~ R15)
BAL (Balance): sets the sound balance between the right and left speakers. (L 15 ~ R15)
EQ (Equalizer style): selects the one of the 7 EQ styles (EQ OFF, POP, ROCK, COUNTRY, VOICE, JAZZ, CLASSIC)
VOL (Volume): sets the sound volume level. (VOL 0 ~ VOL 41)

step.cmd: Turn the VOLUME dial left/right to adjust the value of the level, balance or style.

ul.li: Press the LOUD button to turn loudness mode on/off.

result.p: Increases the level for low frequency.
To turn the loudness option off, press the LOUD button again.

ul.li: Press the MUTE button to turn mute on. "MUTE" will flash on the display and mute the sound.

result.p: Press the MUTE button again or turn VOLUME dial to restore sound.
